output.summary: A perennial herb found throughout tropical and subtropical regions worldwide, it thrives in marshes and other wetlands and can tolerate highly saline water. In southern Iraq’s Mesopotamian Marshes, its pollen is reportedly made into a dessert called khirret, though the source flags this claim as needing a full citation.
